name: Honorable Vanguard's Floating Memory pays a champion level-up's memory cost from the graveyard
notes: Honorable Vanguard's only ability is the unconditional Floating Memory keyword (while paying a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost). This is tested by paying Lorraine, Wandering Warrior's 1-memory champion level-up cost entirely from a Honorable Vanguard seeded directly into the graveyard, with no myMemory filler seeded at all -- QueueMaterializeFloatingPaymentChoice (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/MaterializeLogic.php) detects it via GetMaterializeFloatingChoices' floatingMemoryOnly ZoneSearch and offers it as the sole payment source, an MZMULTICHOOSE ("0|1|myGraveyard-0"). A plain single mzId submission (myGraveyard-0) resolves it -- PAYFLOATING's own comment confirms it tolerates a single-selection response alongside the general "&"-delimited multi-select format. The level-up completes (myField-0 becomes Lorraine, Wandering Warrior) with the graveyard back to empty, confirming Honorable Vanguard itself was banished as the payment.

rulesClauses: Floating Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.)
